reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is physically problematic because W and Cu are immiscible and do not interdiffuse to form a graded layer; the proposed mechanism of interdiffusion at 950–1050 °C contradicts well-established phase equilibria.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and would decisively falsify the hypothesis by checking for a graded interfacial layer and improved thermal conductivity, but the hypothesis itself is based on a flawed premise.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it proposes a mechanism (interdiffusion in an immiscible system) that is fundamentally incorrect, so testing it would not advance understanding of the problem.
